description: One row per product, with English category name resolved.
text_chunk:
Table: analytics.dim_product
Description: One row per product, with English category name resolved.
Columns:
  - product_id (character varying(32))
  - product_category_name (character varying(100))
  - product_category_name_en (character varying(100))
  - product_weight_g (integer)
  - product_length_cm (integer)
  - product_height_cm (integer)
  - product_width_cm (integer)
  - product_photos_qty (smallint)

description: One row per zip code, with representative lat/lng/city/state.
text_chunk:
Table: analytics.dim_geography
Description: One row per zip code, with representative lat/lng/city/state.
Columns:
  - zip_code_prefix (character varying(5))
  - lat (numeric)
  - lng (numeric)
  - city (character varying)
  - state (bpchar)

Table: analytics.dim_customer
Description: One row per customer.
Columns:
  - customer_id (character varying(32))
  - customer_unique_id (character varying(32))
  - zip_code_prefix (character varying(5))
  - city (character varying(100))
  - state (character(2))

Table: analytics.dim_seller
Description: One row per seller.
Columns:
  - seller_id (character varying(32))
  - zip_code_prefix (character varying(5))
  - city (character varying(100))
  - state (character(2))

description: One row per calendar day, spanning the full range of orders.
text_chunk:
Table: analytics.dim_date
Description: One row per calendar day, spanning the full range of orders.
Columns:
  - date_day (date)
  - year (integer)
  - month (integer)
  - month_name (text)
  - day_of_month (integer)
  - day_of_week (integer)
  - quarter (integer)
  - is_weekend (boolean)

description: One row per order line item. See the model's SQL comment for an important caveat about order_total_payment_value being repeated across items of the same order -- never SUM it directly.
text_chunk:
Table: analytics.fact_orders
Description: One row per order line item. See the model's SQL comment for an important caveat about order_total_payment_value being repeated across items of the same order -- never SUM it directly.

Columns:
  - order_id (character varying(32))
  - order_item_id (smallint)
  - customer_id (character varying(32))
  - product_id (character varying(32))
  - seller_id (character varying(32))
  - order_date (date)
  - order_status (character varying(20))
  - order_purchase_timestamp (timestamp without time zone)
  - order_delivered_customer_date (timestamp without time zone)
  - order_estimated_delivery_date (timestamp without time zone)
  - order_total_payment_value (numeric)
  - payment_methods_count (bigint)
  - max_installments (smallint)
  - price (numeric(10,2))
  - freight_value (numeric(10,2))
  - item_total (numeric)
  - product_category_name_en (character varying(100))
  - seller_state (character(2))
